notes: Retrial after the appeal court set aside 80 000 of the 150 000 originally awarded. The claim is ONLY art. 446 § 4 zadośćuczynienie for the death of her 8-year-old daughter (the husband also died; that is a separate case against UFG, also 100 000). The plaintiff was injured in the same crash (incapacitated). 100 000 appropriate − 30 000 paid = 70 000, awarded in the earlier judgment and upheld; this judgment dismisses the remaining 80 000. The claimed 8 102.74 capitalised interest is excluded.
